testCase.name: [本地] S21 No OpenAI project key reaches the browser; only a short-lived session credential

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S21 「OpenAI 项目 key 不会到浏览器；只有一个短时有效的会话凭证」 No OpenAI project key reaches the browser; only a short-lived session credential

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 GPT-live is the active dictation engine on every platform (no on-device or native recogniser on phones either, Daniela 2026-10-09), routed server-side, with no API key in the browser.（TFA-94423 AC 1；TFA-94423 latest decision (Daniela 2026-10-09)）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given The S01 live run in Chromium, and the web and mobile bundles built out of tree with Vite only

When Capture every request the page makes to api.openai.com during H-01, and scan the built bundle

Then The only credential the browser sends is the value prepareSession returned for that take, expiring within 60 s; no 'sk-' style key appears in any request, response or bundle file

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94423 AC 1 'no API key in the browser'. Whether the browser-to-OpenAI audio path counts as 'routed server-side' is Q7, recorded not judged. Unit test 'backend fixes the model and returns only an ephemeral credential with safe audit metadata' (e2e/unit/live-session-action.unit.ts, unit config) is supporting evidence

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-23.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：code-review。

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status partial → 待人看（部分：能查的这半通过，另一半要别的 lane / 人 / 文件 → 待人看）。

Detail:

Bundle half: web + mobile vite builds of e02167f: sk-(proj-|svcacct-|admin-)? key pattern absent; OPENAI_API_KEY name absent; the OPENAI_API_KEY canary set at build time is not in either bundle. Capture half (the bearer the browser sends equals prepareSession's value and expires within 60 s) is the dictation harness, not run here.

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

这个用例别处也有结果（一个用例只显示一个：有结论的优先于卡住，跑过的优先于跳过；同一档取较差的，一样差取先的（dev、dev 的 lane、本地 lane A/C、本地新 lane），测试过时排在通过前面；都是跳过时取 dev 的，除非 dev 只说「本地专用 / dev 上跑不了」或和 lane 同一个原因）：

  • [本地 aicheck-dictation] 通过（aicheck-dictation/results.json） — aicheck-dictation: passed → 通过（通过） H-01 take landed: true; prepareSession rows ["gpt-live-transcribe"]. 6/6 decided cells pass Record-only (needs a decision): Q7 browser→OpenAI audio path counts as 'routed server-side'? — recorded, not judged (Q7): the browser streams audio straight to api.openai.com over WebRTC with the ek_ credential; only the credential is minted server-side. prepareSession: 1…
